question: Does the T-Systems eShop ask a buyer for a card or a phone number when booking T Cloud Public, and does it accept a non-EU business?
why: the eShop cart page https://shop.t-systems.de/eshop/agb/en/product/T_CLOUD_PUBLIC/TSI answered HTTP 503 on 2026-11-06 through the broker read, the direct fetch and the pinned jina-keyless, firecrawl and browserless reads, and the Wayback Machine holds no capture, so the card and phone requirements at booking are unread; the vendor FAQ states only that the offer is limited to business users in Europe
